tasks.subject: Task 1: Delete hand-written models, swap all consumers, fix the broken test fixture
tasks.description:
**Goal:** maia-elasticsearch builds and tests pass using only the generated DTOs; the 4 hand-written model files no longer exist.

**Files:**
- Delete: models/{EsIndexHealthDto,EsIndexName,EsIndexStateDto,ManagedEsIndexInfoDto}.ts
- Modify: public-api.ts, elastic-indices-api-service.ts, elastic-indices-page.ts, elastic-indices-page-store.ts, create-index-dialog.ts, set-index-version-active-dialog.ts, elastic-indices-filtering.ts, elastic-index.ts, elastic-index.html, elastic-indices-filtering.spec.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 4 model files deleted, nothing imports them
- every consumer imports generated types via @app/gen-components/...
- elastic-indices-filtering.ts and elastic-index.ts/.html drop ?./!! on health/managedIndexInfo
- test fixture rebuilt against real generated shape, no unsafe cast
- 'no health status' test removed (no longer expressible)
- build succeeds, tests pass

**Verify:** npx ng build maia-elasticsearch && npx ng test maia-elasticsearch (from libs/maia-ui-workspace). NO GIT COMMIT.
